Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier — really helpful to understand Streamline AI's latency targets for inference and the scale characteristics you described (bursting to ~200 req/s with typical sequence lengths ~256). Per our conversation, the natural next step is a focused ML/Infra deep-dive (60–90 minutes) with your engineering and infra leads so we can map recommendations (batching, KV caching, quant profiles) to an ops plan.

Quick recap of goals for the session:
- Walk through your current inference topology and hot paths
- Surface performance targets and constraints (SLA/regions)
- Run through a sample request flow and KV cache opportunities
- Align on mutual action items and a rollout timeline

Can you confirm the attendee roster you'd like on the call? Ideally we'll have: one infra/sre lead, one ML engineer owning model runtime, and your PM for success criteria.

Proposed window: 60–90 minutes. I'm including two preliminary prep docs as attachments (mutual action plan and a suggested agenda).

If helpful, here are a few time blocks we can tentatively hold (all in PT):
- Tue 27 Apr, 09:00–10:30
- Tue 27 Apr, 13:00–14:30
- Wed 28 Apr, 10:00–11:30

If none of these work, tell me your team's preferred windows and we'll adapt. Once you confirm attendees I can loop in our infra lead (Karthik) and send a calendar invite with a short pre-read checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Rachel Kim
